The deeper follow-up questions are whether pretraining leverage near 1 depends on evaluating on prose, whether the same pattern holds for code or math distributions, and whether leverage could serve as an online signal for mid-training, cooldown, or continual pretraining decisions.103:T554,The theory defines a world as a finite set of states, with each modality providing an injective rendering of those states. A JEPA in each modality is trained on positive pairs whose underlying world states are sampled from a symmetric positive-pair distribution. For JEPAs with whitened second-order anti-collapse, the optimum is the spectral embedding of the positive-pair kernel. If multiple modalities share the same positive-pair distribution over world states, and the optimum is unique up to rotation, then each modality solves the same spectral embedding problem in different coordinates. Their representations therefore match up to a rotation, which the authors call the Platonic Representation Theorem. When the positive-pair distributions differ, misalignment is bounded by the mismatch between those distributions. The paper also analyzes nuisance variables: if positives preserve more of a modality-specific nuisance direction than the k-th world direction, a k-dimensional embedding will spend capacity on that nuisance, and no rotation can align it away. Good-view JEPAs use two observations of the same scene as positives; bad-view JEPAs form positives by corrupting or continuing a single observation. Next-token prediction is placed in the latter class, with prefix-continuation pairs and the softmax log-partition acting as an anti-collapse term.104:T682,The empirical results test the good-view claim across text, image, and video settings. With matched texts and encoders, good views usually produce the strongest alignment, from 145k Flickr captions to text associated with 940M web images, with both trained-from-scratch and frozen image encoders. Alignment follows a scaling law in the fraction of good views and the number of samples seen; the fitted law predicts 85 new runs with error comparable to rerunning the same configuration with another seed. On the PRH benchmark, a 33M-parameter text JEPA trained on the text of 50M web images reaches 0.125, compared with 0.034 on Flickr captions, roughly matching Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B. On the same corpus, the good-view JEPA reaches with 21.6M training samples the alignment that next-token prediction reaches with 900M samples, a 42x sample gap. A 109M-parameter text JEPA trained on the text of 940M web images and exposed to 116B text tokens reaches 0.184, above the evaluated language models up to Qwen2.5-72B at 0.154 and above the CLIP text encoder at 0.124. Start with Section 2.1, where the key step is showing why a whitened JEPA learns the spectral embedding of its positive-pair distribution and why shared positives imply alignment up to rotation. Then read Section 2.2 for the mismatch bound, which is the bridge from the clean theorem to imperfect real data. The paper provides a fairly complete derivation path from constrained entropy minimization to attention, instead of treating attention as an empirical neural module that happened to work. More specifically, it interprets softmax choice, query-key interactions, and value aggregation as consequences of a Gibbs-tilted posterior over random measures. This matters in three ways. First, attention is framed as the minimal departure from an unstructured prior needed to encode sentence-level relational statistics. Second, the query-key matrix can be read as a natural parameter, or Lagrange-multiplier object, associated with those statistics, which is useful when thinking about what training is actually fitting. Third, the paper places Transformers inside a measure-valued statistical language model, making contact with score-based and flow-style viewpoints. For pretraining researchers, this is not a plug-in method paper; it is a theory paper that sharpens the modeling picture around attention.107:Ta2c,The technical story has three layers.

First is the representation layer. The paper starts from two empirical observations: normalized token states are approximately constrained to a sphere, and self-attention without positional information is permutation-equivariant over tokens. This motivates representing a sentence of length n as an empirical measure μ_n = (1/n)∑δ_{x_i} on S^d. A language is then a distribution over such measures, P* ∈ P(P(S^d)).

Second is the maximum-entropy posterior. The null model N samples a sentence length and then draws tokens i.i.d. uniformly on the sphere. Given a vector of sentence-level statistics Φ, the posterior is defined as the KL projection of N onto the set of laws matching the observed expectation of Φ. Under standard regularity conditions, the solution is an exponential-family or Gibbs tilt, P^Φ ∝ exp(<V^Φ, Φ>) N. The crucial point is not the existence of the Gibbs form itself, but that the predictive law of the last token can be expressed through a score driven by the variational derivative δΦ associated with inserting a token into the sentence.

Third is the construction of statistics that recover attention. The paper argues that the statistics must encode token-token interaction, and it builds such a statistic using Luce’s choice axiom truncated at the lowest relational order. That truncation is the key modeling move: it keeps the simplest pairwise relational structure while avoiding higher-order interactions that would lead to more complex predictive rules. Under this choice, the last-token predictive distribution becomes a softmax choice rule, with mean parameter given by an attention cross-moment. The query-key matrix Λ = Q^T K appears as the bilinear interaction parameter, while the value matrix V corresponds to the direction in which the statistic is read out. In that sense, attention is not postulated first and justified later; it is induced by the constrained posterior over random measures.

The paper also extends the construction to causal and multi-head settings. In the causal case, positional information is folded into the state space or the statistics so that the predictive law depends only on the visible prefix. In the multi-head case, different heads correspond to different statistic channels or parameter blocks. The embedding and unembedding stages are discussed separately, since the main derivation works directly on spherical token states. The scope is therefore clear: the paper explains the attention sublayer, not the full residual-MLP-stack training dynamics of modern Transformers.108:T5b1,This is not an empirical scaling paper. Its main results are theoretical statements and derivations rather than benchmark numbers. The key deliverables are:

1. A constrained KL minimization problem over laws on random measures, with conditions under which the optimizer exists and has Gibbs form.
2. A predictive law for the last token under that Gibbs posterior, expressed through a score involving the variational derivative of the chosen sentence-level statistics.
3. A specific statistic built from a low-order truncation of Luce’s choice axiom, under which the predictive rule becomes softmax and the mean parameter is identified with an attention cross-moment.
4. Parallel derivations for unordered, causal, and multi-head variants, showing that the framework is not limited to the simplest bag-of-tokens setting.

From a pretraining perspective, the important observation is what the paper does not claim. It does not show that standard next-token Transformer training explicitly optimizes this entropy projection objective. It does not train large models with this objective and compare perplexity or downstream performance. The evidence is therefore mathematical coherence rather than empirical superiority. The strongest takeaway is structural: once one accepts spherical token states, an unstructured prior, sentence-level constraints, and a low-order Luce-style relational statistic, softmax attention is no longer an arbitrary design choice.109:T79c,Read it in the order of setup, entropy projection, statistic design, then extensions.

Start with the introduction and the early modeling sections to internalize the target of explanation. The paper is not trying to derive every component of the Transformer. It is trying to derive the attention mechanism as a predictive rule in a statistical model of language.

Then read carefully the section that formulates the KL minimization problem and proves the Gibbs-tilt solution. Focus on the assumptions behind existence and uniqueness, and on how the last-token predictive law is extracted from the posterior. This is the mathematical backbone.

Next, spend most of the time on the construction of Φ and on the role of the variational derivative δΦ. The genuinely interesting part is not that maximum entropy gives an exponential family; that is standard. The interesting part is which statistics make the predictive score look exactly like attention.

The section based on Luce’s choice axiom deserves the closest reading. That is where softmax appears for a reason rather than by fiat, and where the bilinear query-key interaction is selected instead of a more complicated higher-order form. If you only track one chain of formulas, track the one that turns the last-token conditional law into a softmax and identifies its mean parameter with the attention cross-moment.

After that, read the causal and multi-head extensions as a coverage check: can the framework accommodate the structures that matter in actual Transformers? The embedding/unembedding discussion can be deferred if time is limited.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. Which assumptions are mathematically convenient versus empirically plausible for trained representations? And can this constrained-law viewpoint be generalized to masked, any-order, diffusion, or energy-based language models? The paper does not answer that, but it opens a useful route.10a:T8db,The setup fine-tunes the base LM to explain itself, rather than training a separate probe. Given an input x and a natural-language query qc that specifies a target locale c inside the model, the system must report the corresponding internal signal. The locale can identify a layer, token position, neuron index, attention head, or attention source-target pair. The authors first cache the true activation a_c(x) from the original forward pass, then train a LoRA-adapted version of the same model to output a discretized or verbalized prediction of that signal conditioned on (x, qc). Because the target is the model's own low-level state, supervision is exact and can be generated at scale.

The central methodological move is to separate endogenous and intervention settings. In the endogenous case, the target signal arises naturally from the input. In the intervention case, the target internal variable is explicitly modified during the forward pass. The paper argues that many prior introspection setups can be solved by detecting that something unusual was injected, rather than by reading the intended internal state. To address this, the authors compare ordinary SFT against interventional training, where intervention examples are included during training so that correlated shortcuts become less reliable and the model is pushed toward the actual target signal.

The mechanism analysis goes beyond behavior. The authors trace the attention heads involved in moving information relevant to introspection. They find that endogenous and intervention reporting rely on overlapping but distinct circuits. Endogenous reporting often uses a larger set of heads to transport naturally occurring internal information, while intervention-related heads behave more like gates that selectively attend to the introspection token when an intervention is present. This distinction is important: being able to report an injected anomaly is not the same capability as reading naturally generated internal states.

Relative to external explainers or hidden-state probes, the paper's distinguishing feature is that the same model is trained to report its own low-level signals in context, under a setup where causal interventions make bypass diagnosable rather than invisible.10b:T640,The study trains hundreds of introspectors across models, signal types, and target locales. Four findings stand out. First, standard SFT can achieve high empirical reporting accuracy, but intervention-based tests and circuit analysis reveal substantial causal bypass. In other words, good answers do not guarantee that the model is using the intended internal variable. Second, adding interventions during training improves reporting of endogenous signals, with especially clear gains on out-of-distribution data. That suggests the method is not just fitting templates; it is making the model rely on more robust internal evidence. Third, generalization is asymmetric: transfer across token positions is relatively good, but transfer to unseen neurons or unseen layers is weak. The paper argues that this looks more like a coverage issue than a hard capability limit, since adding data for more neurons and layers improves performance. Fourth, the circuit analysis shows partially overlapping but functionally distinct attention heads for endogenous versus intervention reporting; endogenous circuits often involve more heads, while intervention circuits look more selective and gate-like.

The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact scores are not recoverable here. Still, the experimental structure is already informative: the authors do not rely on a single average accuracy metric, but separate endogenous vs intervention, in-distribution vs OOD, and seen vs unseen positions/layers/neurons. That makes the conclusions much stronger than a standard finetuning benchmark.10c:T402,Start with the introduction. The main point is not that neuron activations are intrinsically the most important introspection target, but that they are precise, intervenable, and falsifiable, which makes them ideal for studying causal bypass. Then read the method section carefully to understand how locales are defined and how endogenous and intervention examples differ.

After that, go straight to the main behavioral results comparing standard SFT and interventional training, especially on endogenous and OOD evaluations. If time is limited, focus on the task setup, the main comparison tables, and the circuit-analysis section.10d:T8e7,方法上，作者延续 representation engineering 的思路，但把对象从“拒答”这类近似二元门控行为，换成了连续的生成式修辞策略。具体做法是：先构造一个 1000 条的配对数据集，每个概念都要求模型分别给出 literal explanation 和 analogical explanation。数据来自 ELI5 相关社区问答，经过两轮 LLM 过滤与标注：先筛掉不适合做结构类比的意见类、政策类问题，再按 biology、chemistry、CS/technology、earth/environment、economics、engineering、history/society、physics 八个领域做近均匀采样。训练/验证/测试切分为 600/100/300。

在每一层，作者取最终 prompt token 的 residual activation，分别对 analogy 与 literal 两组求均值，做 difference-in-means，得到该层的 Analogy Vector。推理时在指定层把该向量按系数 α 加到残差流上，观察输出风格是否朝类比解释偏移。这里有两个技术点比较关键。第一，作者系统比较了七组 matched base/instruct 模型，覆盖 Gemma-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5，参数规模 2B 到 32B，用同一套提取与干预流程来比较“方向是否存在”和“方向是否可用”。第二，他们发现高系数干预会出现 mode collapse，原因不是语义方向本身失效，而是 lexical entanglement：向量里混入了明显的词汇触发成分，尤其是 “Imagine” token 的 unembedding 方向约占总范数的 10%，会把模型硬推向模板化开头。为此作者把向量投影到与该 token 方向正交的子空间，范数只下降 1%–5%，说明主体信号仍是语义性的，而不是单纯的词触发。

更有意思的是作者提出的“behavioral accessibility”框架。不是只看能否提取出方向，而是看该方向注入后，模型分布是否真的发生可传播、可利用的变化。这里他们用两类信号来刻画：一类是输出质量和 analogy score 的提升；另一类是干预前后 token 分布的 KL divergence。后者被作者解释为 wiring diagnostic：即使模型最终没生成高质量类比，只要 KL 明显上升，说明这条方向至少接入了生成路径；如果 KL 很低，则更像是几何上有痕迹，但没有被行为电路有效读取。10e:T926,The method follows the representation-engineering line of work, but moves from near-binary behaviors such as refusal to a continuous generative style. The authors build a paired dataset of 1,000 concepts, each eliciting both a literal explanation and an analogical explanation. The source is ELI5-style community QA data, filtered in two stages with an external LLM: first to keep only mechanism-like concepts suitable for structural analogy, then to assign each item to one of eight domains for near-balanced sampling. The final split is 600/100/300 for train/validation/test.

For each layer, they collect the residual activation at the final prompt token and compute a difference-in-means vector between analogy and literal examples. This yields a layer-wise Analogy Vector. At inference time, they add the vector with coefficient alpha to the residual stream before the attention and MLP blocks, then measure whether the output shifts toward analogical explanation style.

Two technical details matter. First, they run the same extraction-and-steering pipeline on seven matched base/instruct pairs from Gemma-2, Llama-3.1, and Qwen-2.5, spanning 2B to 32B parameters. This lets them compare not just whether the direction exists, but whether it is behaviorally usable. Second, they identify a concrete failure mode at high steering strength: lexical entanglement. The vector partially aligns with the unembedding direction of the token “Imagine,” which accounts for about 10% of the vector norm and can force templated generations. They remove this by orthogonalizing the steering vector against that token direction. The norm drops by only 1%–5%, suggesting the main signal is semantic rather than lexical.

The broader contribution is the behavioral accessibility framework. The paper argues that extracting a direction is not enough; one must test whether the intervention actually enters the model’s generation circuitry. To measure this, they use both output-side quality metrics and KL divergence between steered and unsteered token distributions. They interpret KL as a wiring diagnostic: even if the final generations are not yet good analogies, a substantial KL shift indicates that the direction is connected to the decoding pathway. Low KL suggests a representation that is geometrically present but behaviorally inert.10f:T5d8,The central empirical result is that the Analogy Vector can be extracted from every base model tested, but accessibility varies continuously with instruction exposure rather than following a clean base-versus-instruct split. Gemma-2 base models, where pretraining and instruction tuning are more cleanly separated, show flat steering landscapes and much lower KL divergence than their instruct counterparts. The direction is there, but it barely moves behavior. Qwen-2.5 base models, where instruction-like data is more entangled with pretraining, already show partial accessibility. Llama-3.1 sits between these two regimes.

On the held-out set of 300 prompts, the paper reports that steering Gemma-2-9B-IT with the extracted direction improves the harmonic mean of literal quality and analogy quality from 3.22 to 3.94, a gain of about 22%. A small human validation study supports the use of the LLM judge for analogy quality. Another useful result is the base-instruct cosine similarity analysis: Qwen base/instruct pairs remain geometrically close, while Gemma pairs show larger reorganization, consistent with the idea that instruction tuning amplifies and hooks into existing structure in Qwen but reshapes it more substantially in Gemma. The appendix analysis of high-alpha failures is also informative: once the “Imagine” component is removed, mode collapse is reduced, indicating that many steering failures come from lexical leakage rather than the absence of a semantic direction.110:T54c,A two-phase auditing pipeline.
Phase 1 (candidate discovery): define forced-choice behavior via the logit margin between the gold option and the strongest competing option, plus auxiliary measures (entropy, gold/wrong probabilities). Encode residual-stream activations with pretrained Gemma Scope SAEs, pool feature activations over specific spans (max-pooling over tokens), and rank features using L1-regularized logistic probes for several binary targets (e.g., Wrong vs Correct, low vs high margin, wrong-high-confidence variants) and ridge regression for continuous targets (margin/entropy). Complement probes with statistical audits (Pearson/Spearman correlations, bootstrap mean-difference intervals, mutual information estimates).
Artifact-risk screening: for sufficiently supported features, explicitly test confounds tied to evaluation structure (answer letter, prompt template, answer permutation, topic/content cues). Convert each confound score to within-run percentiles and filter out high-risk features.
Phase 2 (causal evaluation): perform feature steering/interventions and measure distributional shifts in margins and actual answer flips (wrong→correct), with random-active feature controls. The paper emphasizes that large logit influence and high predictiveness are insufficient without artifact independence and stable causal effects.111:T62e,The task is deliberately simple. There are four labeled boxes and four letters A–D. Starting from an initial arrangement, the model must apply k swaps, with k in {2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24}, writing the full state after each swap and then the final answer. Because every intermediate state is deterministic, step correctness can be scored exactly. The key intervention is the Edit condition: after the model has produced a partial chain up to step m, the state at step m is replaced with a different but valid arrangement, and the model is asked to continue. If the continuation and final answer evolve consistently from the corrupted state, the run is labeled follows-edit; if the model returns to the true trajectory, it is labeled repair; other categories capture additional failure modes.

This design has several strengths. The intervention is applied to the model’s own chain rather than to an externally written explanation, so it directly tests whether the model uses previously written text as computational input. The corrupted state is valid, which prevents trivial rejection based on malformed formatting. The paper also separates compliance, prefix accuracy, CoT accuracy, and direct accuracy, so reliance is not conflated with formatting failures, low capability, or answer bias.

The evaluation spans 25 open-weight models: Qwen3 size series with both base and post-trained variants, Gemma 3, Llama 3, and multiple OLMo 2 pretraining checkpoints. The protocol runs on a single 16GB GPU, which makes it a practical diagnostic rather than a one-off large-scale benchmark.112:T6b3,There are five headline findings. First, reliance rises monotonically with size and then saturates. In Qwen3, the follows-edit rate is well fit by a logistic curve in log parameter count, with a midpoint near 1B, reaching 0.97–1.00 by 14B. Gemma 3 and Llama 3 show the same qualitative trend. Second, capability is the main explanatory variable. Across all 25 models, reliance and step accuracy correlate at about r = 0.99; at matched capability, models from different families and sizes show similar reliance, such as 1.7B Qwen3, 4B Gemma 3, and 8B Llama 3. Third, size still matters beyond raw correctness: even when restricting to items the model originally solved correctly before the edit, reliance continues to increase with size among capable models. Fourth, post-training is not the main driver. For Qwen3, base and post-trained checkpoints differ by at most about ±0.03 in reliance from 4B upward; the only large gap appears at 1.7B and coincides with a large capability gap. Fifth, for k >= 4, direct answering without a chain stays at chance for all capable models, with mean accuracy 0.041 versus the theoretical 1/24 ≈ 0.042. That strongly suggests there is no hidden internal shortcut on this task at these scales: if the model solves it, it does so by using the explicit step-by-step trace.

The OLMo 2 checkpoint results are also informative as a limitation. The authors intended to probe the training-token axis, but those checkpoints never cross the capability threshold needed for the task, so the token-scaling analysis remains inconclusive. That itself is useful: more pretraining tokens do not automatically place a model in the high-reliance regime on this kind of serial reasoning task.113:T4cd,The evaluation uses fact-checked PolitiFact claims from LIAR-PLUS, collapsed into true and false classes after filtering for length, attribution, first-person wording, and image-dependent phrasing. Each prompt asks a fact-checking assistant to answer whether a social-media post is true or false. The account profile is randomized across age, gender, origin, education, occupation, track record, followers, party, and irrelevant attributes. Occupation and education are sampled jointly to keep profiles plausible. The primary condition uses natural biography lines rather than explicit profile cards. The metric reads next-token probabilities after “Answer:” and renormalizes over several single-token spellings of True and False. The job gap is measured in probit space, either through claim-fixed-effect regression for randomized profiles or paired differences for minimal pairs. For OLMo-2 32B, the paper examines base, SFT, DPO, and final checkpoints. It builds a difference-of-means status direction in the residual stream and tests it with activation steering. Source-choice labels are obtained through answer-alias matching, while disclosure labels are produced by an LLM judge with categories such as one-sided answers, conflict-aware leaning answers, strict unresolved disclosure, weak disclosure, and truncation. For source choice, the paper fits a mean-difference direction in the residual stream: the normalized difference between the residual centroids for Document 1 and Document 2 answers. This direction is used both as a readout and as a steering vector. In Qwen, the selected source-choice direction is at layer 13 and the mean_decision position; steering is applied at the output of layer 12 so that layer 13 receives the edited residual. The paper then uses CETT to identify sparse MLP neurons whose activation and down-projection norm imply a large contribution to the MLP residual write. The actual neuron writes are projected onto the source-choice direction to test whether those sparse writers feed the same coordinate. Conflict disclosure is modeled separately and appears later, at layer 17 and pre_response_last in Qwen.115:T46d,The authors recast Neural Thickets as a Perturb-Select-Vote procedure. PSV samples N perturbed predictors, scores them on a small task-specific validation set, keeps the top K members, and aggregates their predictions by majority vote. Full-weight RandOpt is one instance of this template. The paper then weakens the perturbation space step by step: perturbing all parameters, perturbing a subset of layers, perturbing a single decoder block, and finally perturbing no weights at all. In the logit-only variant, the model is fully frozen and each member receives a fixed random Gaussian bias added to its output logits throughout autoregressive generation, followed by greedy decoding. A first-order argument supports this move: small weight perturbations affect predictions primarily through the logit shifts they induce. The paper also separates the roles of sampling, selection, and voting. On stronger base models, temperature-tuned sampling with majority voting already matches much of full-weight PSV; on weaker models, validation-based selection remains more important because it filters unreliable members before aggregation.116:T413,The paper reproduces the large gains reported by Gan and Isola, including the Countdown example where Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct improves from 10.8% to 63.6% under the original perturbation setup. The central empirical result is that full-weight perturbation is not necessary. Perturbing a single decoder block recovers much of the gain, and logit-only PSV often matches or exceeds full-weight PSV. On MATH-500 with OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the base model scores 63.3%, full-weight perturbation ensemble reaches 74.7%, and logit-only PSV reaches 81.3%. The PSV runs use large perturbation budgets, typically N from 1000 to 5000, and a selection set of about 200 target-task examples. The paper also evaluates pretrained vision backbones under domain shift. There, logit-only PSV uses one trained linear probe and perturbs class logits, while full-weight PSV perturbs the backbone and trains one probe per member. The same pattern holds: output-space perturbations recover the gains of full-weight perturbations and can improve out-of-domain performance.117:T420,The study uses a counterfactual fairness setup. The authors take 120 real emergency department cases from MIMIC-IV and create demographic swaps while keeping the clinical content fixed. They run a full factorial design over five model families and four aggregation topologies, yielding 20 model-by-topology cells. The analysis compares independent agent outputs with the final committed team decision. The central mechanism is called disparity laundering: the team optimizes within-version quantities such as agreement, coherence, and clinical plausibility, but the fairness property lives between paired counterfactual versions of the same patient. Since no agent observes both versions, the deliberation process cannot distinguish a harmful dissent from an error to be smoothed out. The paper tests late-stage interventions such as fairness instructions, demographic masking, and per-agent self-debiasing. It then introduces a Diverse-Perspective Ensemble that makes counterfactual versions visible inside the team and pools them into the final decision.118:T5c7,The setup is simple and appropriately controlled. The authors evaluate Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Gemma-4-E2B with a minimal prompt of the form “x1 × x2 =”, using greedy decoding to avoid chain-of-thought or tool use masking the raw failure pattern. The dataset contains 16,991 multiplication problems spanning 1x1, 1x2, 2x2, 2x3, 2x4, 3x3, and 3x4 settings. Small spaces are exhaustively enumerated; larger ones are uniformly sampled.
The analysis has three layers. First, they measure exact-answer and per-digit accuracy as operand length grows. Second, they port the carry-potential framework from Wen et al. on addition and test whether multiplication errors also form the characteristic bathtub-shaped curve around integer boundaries. Third, after finding that this pattern does not hold cleanly, they inspect the structure of wrong digits themselves. The main empirical observation is a new regime in small Qwen models: lower-order digit errors often preserve parity, while higher-order errors look more like off-by-one carry failures.
That last point is the real contribution. It suggests multiplication errors are not generated by a single source of discretization noise. Lower columns may be governed by local multiplication-table-like heuristics, while higher columns are more affected by carry propagation. This is a better fit to the computational structure of multiplication than a direct transfer of the addition hypothesis.119:T565,The experimental scale is modest but the design is clean. The dataset has 16,991 problems: 81 for 1x1, 810 for 1x2, 8,100 for 2x2, and sampled subsets for larger settings, including 3,000 each for 2x3 and 3x3, and 1,000 each for 2x4 and 3x4. All models are run with greedy decoding and up to 10 generated tokens, with regex-based answer extraction.
Three findings matter most. First, digit-level error rate versus carry potential does not reproduce the clear bathtub shape seen in addition. The authors argue this is because multiplication has much larger and more variable carry potentials, and because errors from partial products and subsequent summation are entangled. Their 99 x 99 example is illustrative: the tens-column raw sum is 162, and with the previous carry the carry potential can reach 17, far beyond the small bounded values typical in addition.
Second, carry still matters, but it is not a sufficient explanatory variable. Errors increase with more complex carry structure, yet they do not localize neatly around integer thresholds.
Third, small Qwen models exhibit a specific structure: low-order digit mistakes often preserve parity, whereas high-order mistakes resemble off-by-one carry failures. The paper is more about error morphology than headline accuracy, so the figures and qualitative distributions are more informative than any single aggregate score.11a:T7dd,HERD has two coupled components: an evolving harness and a constrained recursive distillation step.

On the harness side, the system does not simply cache raw examples. Instead, it maintains two forms of external state. First, it refines textual skills that summarize reusable patterns from the current and past tasks. Second, it stores a bounded set of high-residual examples that those skills fail to explain well. This split is deliberate. Storing only examples wastes context budget and scales poorly with stream length; storing only abstract skills loses tail cases and exceptions. HERD treats the harness as a selective, fast-learning layer that keeps both abstraction and residual evidence.

On the parametric side, the model is updated by distillation rather than direct supervised finetuning on the raw task stream. The student starts from the previous checkpoint and is trained to match the behavior of the prior system when that system is equipped with the current harness. In effect, the harness organizes and filters experience first, and only then is that experience written into the weights. This is meant to reduce noise and lower drift compared with ordinary SFT.

The central technical idea is drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors. One anchor is the previous checkpoint, which limits per-stage movement and protects short-term retention. The other is the original base model, which limits cumulative drift across many stages and helps preserve broad general capabilities. The paper presents this as the key to recursive stability: the challenge is not merely learning stage t, but still behaving sensibly after stage 20 or 25.

Relative to standard continual finetuning methods such as replay, regularization, or LoRA-based sequential updates, HERD inserts an explicit external selection layer before weight updates. Relative to pure retrieval or prompt-memory approaches, HERD aims to deploy only the consolidated weights, so inference does not inherit an ever-growing context cost.11b:T7c9,The main evaluation uses TRACE+17, a 25-stage task stream composed of 8 TRACE tasks and 17 Super-NaturalInstructions tasks. The reported metrics include final average performance over seen tasks, acquisition, forgetting, and degradation on general capability probes.

The headline result is that HERD reaches a final mean of 0.706 over all seen tasks at the end of the stream, outperforming all baselines and beating the non-parametric methods by 27 points. That gap is important because it supports the paper’s core claim that a harness alone does not scale as a long-term learner under bounded context. At the same time, HERD’s acquisition score is 0.713, statistically indistinguishable from the plasticity floor set by Seq-LoRA, so the method does not buy stability by simply refusing to learn new tasks.

For forgetting, HERD reports 0.010, roughly half or less than every weight-updating baseline except SDFT. The paper notes that SDFT suffers generation collapse, which is an important caveat: low forgetting numbers can be misleading if the model’s outputs degenerate. On general tests, HERD drops by only 6.3 points, whereas other baselines lose around 20.0 to 25.5 points, suggesting that the cumulative-drift control from the base-model anchor is doing real work.

A useful qualitative result is the stage-5-to-stage-12 rule retention example shown in Figure 1: a rule learned earlier remains present in the weights alone, without the harness, across three random seeds. That is stronger evidence of actual consolidation than a small benchmark gain.

The most informative ablations are the ones that separate skills from residual memory, and dual-anchor distillation from weaker update rules. Even from the available text, the intended takeaways are clear: skills and residual examples play complementary roles; distillation is safer than direct SFT for recursive consolidation; and constraining only local drift is not enough when the training process is repeated many times.11c:T61a,Start with the introduction and read it as a position statement, not just motivation. The key question is why the authors reject the idea that stronger models plus longer context windows make pure harness-based continual learning sufficient.

Then move to the method section, especially the harness design and Section 2.4 on drift-constrained distillation. Pay close attention to the division of labor between skills and high-residual memory, and to the distinct roles of the two anchors. If time is limited, the dual-anchor mechanism is the one part to read carefully, because it is the main reason the recursive setup appears stable over 25 stages.

A quick skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes; a careful read is worthwhile if you work on continual pretraining, online distillation, or memory-augmented learning.11d:T473,The framework has two components. GEAR, or Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning, constructs the next continuous input from candidate token embeddings. Starting from the sender logits, it applies temperature scaling and candidate filtering, then reweights candidates using both their probabilities and their embedding-space agreement with other candidates. This differs from Soft Thinking, which simply averages embeddings under the predictive distribution. A candidate receives more weight when it is probable and geometrically supported by other probable candidates. The second component is the H+J communication interface. The H channel maps the sender’s consumed feedback distribution into the receiver’s embedding table, producing receiver-side continuous inputs. The J channel uses a Jacobian lens to read selected vocabulary-indexed coordinates from an intermediate sender state. The sender transmits token IDs and signed readouts; the receiver reconstructs a norm-scaled residual update using its own Jacobian-lens dictionary during prefill. This keeps each model’s KV cache local and supports different hidden dimensions.11e:T4ca,The paper operationalizes the “view from nowhere” principle via Population-Centered Evolution (PCE).

PCE has two stages:
1) Population distillation: for a chosen task, a distillation agent scans task records and modification histories across all evaluated variants and produces a structured population block with:
- Outcome evidence: frequency of outcomes across the population (is a failure systemic or isolated?).
- Observation: a cross-agent comparative hypothesis explaining why some variants succeed and others fail.
- Candidate files: pointers to harness components likely responsible, narrowing the edit search space.
2) Diagnosis and harness modification: the system checks the population-level hypothesis against the selected parent’s traces and source code, then proposes a concrete harness change.

A key design choice is separating the evidence set (all evaluated variants 𝒱) from the parent-eligible archive (𝒜 ⊆ 𝒱). Even variants that will never be selected as parents can still contribute through distilled evidence. Compared with GEA/DGM/HGM, the novelty is less about selection heuristics and more about turning population diversity into explicit diagnostic input for targeted consolidation.11f:T460,Dwell is a model-based RL framework that reframes a pretrained VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator in a POMDP. From histories of observations and actions, it infers a belief state b_t in the VLM’s latent space, predicts transitions and rewards in that space, and uses imagined latent rollouts to improve the policy.

Two implementation choices carry most of the novelty:
- Latent imagination over reconstruction: following joint-embedding style representation learning, it avoids synthesizing observations at every step and instead models predictable structure in a compact latent, reducing imagination cost.
- Dual adapters on one backbone: world/reward modeling and policy learning are instantiated as separate LoRA adapters attached to the same VLM backbone. This keeps a shared representation interface (mitigating latent incompatibility) while enabling parameter-efficient, partially decoupled online updates.

The trade-off is explicit: give up pixel-level generative fidelity to gain cheaper rollouts and a tighter coupling between the latent used for prediction and the latent consumed by the policy.120:T51f,WorkFactory is a pipeline that makes task environments verifiably executable before collecting teacher trajectories.

1) Professional intent library: intents are derived from occupational hierarchies, skill documentation, and real deliverables, so the target output and audience are defined before instantiating materials.

2) Information Support Graph (backward planning): starting from the intended deliverable, the system plans dependencies at the level of information items (premises/conditions) and specifies where each supporting fact should appear across reused/synthesized artifacts, while explicitly leaving derived quantities for the solver.

3) Probe execution + execution-based repair: after materialization, an isolated probe attempts the task using only solver-visible inputs to detect support failures (missing/contradictory premises, broken dependencies). Repairs must restore support without changing the intended work or leaking key derivations.

4) Independent teacher collection: only tasks that pass probe+repair are assigned to a separate teacher agent to generate trajectories for SFT.

5) Component analysis: planning and repair are treated as separable modules; the paper argues they are complementary—planning reduces structural defects, repair catches instantiation-induced defects.121:T4d1,Task Advancement Memory (TAM) uses verified task progress as both online state and offline supervision.

1) Instruction compilation into a requirement graph 𝒬: an LLM-based compiler decomposes the instruction into requirements (info to acquire or outcomes to achieve), dependency edges, per-requirement evidence rules for verification from GUI observations, and optional branch conditions.

2) Task Advancement State (online): maintains each requirement’s status (unresolved/established), known values, evidence, and object bindings. When an observation satisfies an evidence rule, TAM records an advancement and updates the remaining-goal representation—what is done, what inputs are available, and which goals are ready next.

3) Advancement supervision (retrospective): each advancement marks candidate interaction segments; after the episode, TAM selects/abstracts segments that caused verified local results into persistent operations specified by required inputs at entry, the result to achieve, and how to verify it. This salvages useful skills from both successful and failed trajectories.

4) Plug-in design: TAM augments a fixed base policy by providing bounded memory context; it does not retrain the policy itself.122:T836,The system is built around an Explorer–Builder–Verifier loop, with explicit source evidence as the shared interface. The Explorer–Builder collects browser-observable evidence from a real site under a given scope and budget. The evidence includes page structure, computed styles, element geometry, screenshots, resource references, and before/after observations around interactions. A notable design choice is that different interaction states at the same URL are treated as distinct evidence units. That is necessary if the goal is to reconstruct state transitions rather than static snapshots.

The Builder converts this evidence into a local executable environment: routes, components, shared object relations, state transitions, fixed initial states, reset mechanisms, and task evaluators. The reconstruction target is intentionally bounded by a site contract. The system does not try to infer hidden backend logic beyond what the evidence supports. In that sense, it is closer to contract-bounded replayable reconstruction than to full website cloning.

The Verifier is the key differentiator. It runs independently on frozen candidates and checks them against source evidence and site contracts. When it finds a discrepancy, the system asks whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a concrete correction. If yes, the issue is treated as an implementation bug and sent to local repair. If not, the problem is treated as an evidence gap and triggers targeted recapture from the source site. The updated candidate is then frozen and reverified. This separation between evidence-supported repair and evidence-insufficient recapture is the central mechanism that distinguishes the work from one-shot generative reconstruction pipelines.

The broader design trade-off is clear. The paper avoids the high-quality but low-scale route of manual mirrors, and also avoids purely generative site synthesis that scales but may drift from the source. It chooses browser-evidence-driven reconstruction because the target is a training/evaluation environment, not an open-ended web simulator.123:T70b,The evaluation covers scale, fidelity, and downstream utility.

If reading more deeply, examine how much manual effort remains in defining site contracts, and whether targeted recapture scales to longer, deeper workflows rather than shallow interactions.125:T66a,The method has two parts. The first is CoC-CFG. The model runs the frozen action expert twice: once with the full context C_full, and once with a reference context C_ref where only the reasoning span is removed. At Euler step k, it computes two velocities, v_with and v_without, and interpolates along the line between them with a guidance weight w_k. Setting w_k=1 recovers the original policy, w_k=0 removes the reasoning influence, and w_k>1 amplifies it. This turns trust in reasoning from a binary keep/drop decision into a controllable scalar.

The second part is Q-adaptive guidance. The choice of w_k at each step is formulated as an MDP over a finite action set of guidance weights. The key move is to avoid standard bootstrapped RL. Because the expert is frozen, the initial noise is fixed, and the generation process can be reset to any step, the value of taking one candidate weight at one step can be measured exactly: branch for one step with that weight, then finish the rollout under the current controller, and use the final task score as the action value. Small critics are trained to regress these measured Q-values, with an added penalty for deviating from a reference weight. The controller is then improved, new values are re-measured under the improved controller, and the critics are refit on the accumulated measurements.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. It does not try to detect hallucinated reasoning. It does not fine-tune the VLA or update the expert online. And it does not rely on SAC-style or GRPO-style bootstrapping from sparse terminal rewards when exact one-step branching is available.126:T599,The evaluation has two main parts: Alpasim and Waymo. In Alpasim, a simulator reconstructed from real driving logs, Q-adaptive guidance reduces open-loop displacement cost by 16.5% relative to the original w=1 policy. In closed-loop evaluation, it passes 262 out of 300 scenes, compared with 252 for the baseline. Under the same reward signal, it also outperforms SAC and GRPO, which supports the paper’s claim that measured-Q fitting is better matched to this setting than generic online RL.

On the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, the paper compares against fixed guidance weights, four adaptive-guidance baselines, SAC, GRPO, and the original Alpamayo 1.5. The reported result is that the first three stages of the proposed controller already beat all fixed-weight settings and the adaptive/RL baselines on held-out frames. After rule-based conversion to the Waymo vehicle, Alpamayo 1.5 with Q-adaptive guidance reaches 8.135159 RFS on the hidden test set, above the published 8.079 baseline. The absolute gain is modest, but hidden-test improvement matters more than open-loop-only gains.

The most useful ablation insight is that no single global guidance weight works well across scenes or across Euler steps. Another important result is that measured-Q fitting beats SAC and GRPO, which is exactly what the method is designed to exploit: when exact branch evaluation is possible, bootstrapping becomes unnecessary noise.127:T87a,方法名是 Continuous-Action World Models，核心对象是 latent action function。作者不把动作看成固定长度、固定频率的命令序列，而是把一段动作表示成带时间戳的样本点 {(τ_i,a_i,m_i)}，其中 m_i 记录哪些动作分量有效。编码器 E_ϕ 把这些时间采样点压到固定大小的 latent function Z，解码器 D_ψ 接收 Z 和任意物理时间 query τ，输出该时刻的 end-effector action。这样同一动作可以在不同采样频率下被观测和重建，也可以在推理时按目标控制频率重新查询。

训练分两阶段。Stage A 是 function pretraining。作者用一个 Mixture-of-Transformers 编码器分别处理位置、姿态、夹爪等动作流，再通过联合注意力融合，学习跨动作分量的共享表示。预训练目标至少包括两类：一是动作重建，让 latent function 能从时间查询恢复原始轨迹；二是 temporal sampling view consistency，让同一物理动作在不同采样频率、不同时间视图下映射到一致表示。这个设计的关键不是做更强的自编码，而是让 heterogeneous trajectory 在“物理时间”坐标系里对齐，从而扩大可用于预训练的数据池。

Stage B 是把 pretrained function space 接到 world-model backbone。输入侧包括视觉观测、语言指令、机器人 proprioception，以及预测的未来视觉特征；预测头输出 latent function，再由共享 decoder 按指定 query times 解码成动作。文中提到 current visual features 通过 output residual 进入预测头，说明作者不想让 latent function 完全承担当前观测的低层细节，而是更偏向承载跨 embodiment 的 dynamics prior。训练时既监督 latent representation，也监督解码后的动作，形成 representation-level 和 action-level 的双重约束。

和常见 robot policy / world model 的区别在于：它不是直接学 observation-to-action，也不是把不同机器人动作简单投到统一离散 token 空间，而是先定义一个连续时间、固定容量、可跨频率查询的中间函数空间。这个中间层是全文真正的创新点。128:T7ca,The method, Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), centers on a latent action function. Instead of representing an action as a fixed-length command sequence, the paper uses timestamped action samples {(tau_i, a_i, m_i)}, where m_i indicates valid components. An encoder maps these samples into a fixed-size latent function Z, and a decoder takes Z plus arbitrary physical-time queries to produce end-effector actions. This makes it possible to observe the same motion at one sampling rate and execute or reconstruct it at another.

Training has two stages. Stage A is function pretraining. A Mixture-of-Transformers encoder processes position, orientation, and gripper streams with specialized branches and joint attention. The pretraining objectives include action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views, so that the same physical motion observed at different frequencies maps to a shared representation. The point is not just better autoencoding; it is to align heterogeneous trajectories in a common physical-time space and thereby enlarge the pool of usable pretraining data.

Stage B connects the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone. The prediction head consumes visual observations, language instructions, robot proprioception, and predicted future visual features, with current visual features added through an output residual. It predicts a latent action function, and the shared decoder turns that function into actions at query times chosen for the desired execution frequency. Training supervises both the latent representation and the decoded actions, giving the model both representation-level and action-level constraints.

Compared with standard robot policies or world models, the key difference is that the paper does not directly learn observation-to-action mappings in a fixed discrete-time space, and it does not force all robots into a naive shared action tokenization. The continuous-time latent function is the actual contribution.129:T488,The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so the exact numbers are not available here. From the method and framing, the critical evaluations are likely to be: action reconstruction quality under heterogeneous temporal sampling, consistency of the latent space across different frequency views, downstream action generation when execution frequency is changed at inference time, and transfer across embodiments.

The paper’s central empirical claim is that Stage A broadens the trajectory sources that can contribute to pretraining, while Stage B turns that shared prior into observation-conditioned action generation. The most important numbers to verify in the full paper are: how many embodiments and frequency settings are used in pretraining, how much latent-function supervision helps over direct action supervision, and how much performance degrades when the decoder is queried at unseen execution frequencies. If gains only appear as within-embodiment interpolation, the contribution is mostly engineering. If cross-embodiment transfer remains strong, the work is much more relevant as a unified pretraining approach.12a:T406,A 20-minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction and the main method figure to lock in the central claim: actions should be modeled as functions, not fixed-rate sequences. Then read the definition of the latent function and the physical-time interface carefully. After that, focus on Stage A, especially the consistency objective across temporal sampling views; that is what separates this from a standard behavior-cloning autoencoder. Finally, read how Stage B attaches the pretrained function space to the world-model backbone and how inference-time query times determine execution frequency.

The second step ranks candidate continuations with a contrastive fluency score, combining unlearning-induced divergence with linguistic plausibility. Divergence alone tends to produce incoherent token sequences, while fluency alone becomes ordinary generation; the combined score is meant to recover sequences that are both plausible and specifically affected by unlearning. A Critic evaluates a fixed-format evidence package and either accepts candidates or emits a typed diagnosis that permits only local plan repair. 层；注意力栈交错 GQA 与 Sliding Window Attention；引入 query-aware sink token 吸收多余注意力质量；QKNorm 稳定 Q/K 尺度，并对仿射参数做 clip；Partial RoPE 只在部分 head 维度上施加 RoPE；第一层用 dense MLP 替代 MoE 路由以缓解早期层 expert 负载不均。\n2）归一化与深度利用：采用 参数化，用于提升大规模训练效率并让学习率等超参在不同规模间可迁移。配合 Stable SplitNorm，目标是扩大稳定训练区域。\n4）两阶段课程：第二阶段提高 coding 数据占比。动机是先用更广泛语料打底，再用更高代码 mixture 强化 agentic/coding 基础能力，同时避免从一开始就用高代码占比导致分布偏置或不稳定。\n5）mid-training：扩展数据 mixture gradients during training. A longer backward window improves learning per token because credit assignment reaches deeper into the repeated computation, but it also makes each update more expensive. A shorter window reduces backward cost, so under a fixed wall-clock budget it can run more optimizer steps and consume more tokens. The key question is not which window is better at a fixed token count, but whether the preferred choice changes as the training budget grows. That is the practically relevant setting for pretraining, where the constraint is usually total compute or elapsed training time rather than a fixed number of tokens.","importance":"Its value for pretraining is twofold. First, it reframes truncated backpropagation in recurrent/shared-depth LMs as a budget-dependent recipe choice rather than a static architectural preference. The main result is simple: at small budgets, shorter windows often win because extra updates are worth more; at larger budgets, that advantage shrinks systematically. Second, the paper provides a clean decomposition of the matched-time outcome into two components: per-token efficiency from deeper backpropagation, and extended-training gains from cheaper updates. Both diminish as budget increases, but the gains from extra updates diminish faster. That mechanism is likely relevant beyond looped LMs, including truncated BPTT, shared-parameter depth, and other settings where one trades deeper credit assignment against more optimization steps.","technical_approach":"$33","experiments":"$34","reading_guide":"Start with the Introduction, especially the distinction between per-token efficiency and extended-training gains. After that, focus on the main result figures: one set shows matched-time K4 vs K8 differences across budgets, and another uses equal-token controls to decompose the source of the shift. If time is limited, keep one question in mind: why does a short window help more at small budgets than at large ones. Synthetic rewrites are now common in training corpora, but two practical questions remain unresolved: how much compute should be spent generating rewritten documents, and whether a model trained on rewritten data can surpass the model that produced those rewrites. The paper frames this as a scaling-law problem that predicts held-out loss from model size, training tokens, rewrite fraction, epochs over natural seed data, and the compute spent on generation.","importance":"The main contribution is a budget-aware view of synthetic data. The paper does not ask whether synthetic data helps in isolation; it asks how to allocate a fixed compute budget between generating rewrites and training on them. This matters for pretraining because rewrite data has both a quality effect and a compute cost. Ignoring the generation cost can make synthetic data look better than it is. The result that target models can match or exceed their rewriter is also important: rewritten data is not merely a hard ceiling imposed by a teacher model. The optimization is performed with cost-adjusted training FLOPs: the FLOPs used to create rewrites are charged against the same overall budget, leaving fewer FLOPs for target-model training. The paper evaluates two regimes. In the compute-limited regime, natural data is assumed plentiful and rewrites are generated by an external rewriter trained with more compute than the target runs. In the data-limited regime, natural data is bounded and the rewriter is bootstrapped from a subset of the available data using less compute than the target model. This distinction is useful because the first regime resembles small-lab use of third-party models, while the second resembles frontier training pipelines where the previous generation helps prepare data for the next.","experiments":"The scaling law is fit at smaller budgets and extrapolated to larger held-out runs. In the data-limited setting, a law fit at low budgets predicts a high-budget rewrite fraction whose loss is within 1.14% of the best observed fraction. The key claim here is that Euclidean decoding is the wrong lens because embedding norm decay creates spurious overtaking: a low-norm token can appear to beat the source token even when the state still points in the source direction. routing heads，对同一组共享专家从不同参数视角打分。每个路由头先输出 sigmoid 分数，然后把这些 post-sigmoid 分数相加，再做一次共享的 top-k 选择。作者强调必须是 sigmoid 之后再求和，而不是先加 logits 再过非线性；后者在形式上会退化成一个单线性打分器，失去多视角意义。多个路由头没有额外 diversity penalty，只靠不同初始化打破对称性，训练后会自然形成差异化偏好。聚合后的分数既能让“被某一个 router 强烈偏好”的专家入选，也能让“被多个 router 中等支持”的专家入选。\n\nMulti-View 在此基础上进一步让路由偏好参与专家计算本身。问题在于，单纯把多个 router 分数求和后，保留不了各 router 的相对偏好信息；例如两个 router 分别给出 (0.4, 0.1) 和 (0.2, 0.3) 时，总和都可能一样，但语义不同。为此，作者给每个 router 配一个 learned latent projection，对应一个 latent view。对于每个被选中的专家，不是直接吃同一个共享下投影输入，而是先根据该专家在各 router 上的原始分数，跨 router 归一化得到 mixing weights，再把多个 latent views 混合成该专家专属的输入。关键点在于：这种 mixing 发生在 dispatch 之前，但每个被选专家仍只做一次前向，因此 active-expert count、expert FLOPs、通信量都不变。\n\n从设计取舍看，这个方案试图在两端之间找平衡：一端是标准 MoE，成本低但路由视角单一；另一端是对所有专家做部分或全部激活评估，信息更充分但代价高。Multi-View 通过复用 router preference，拿到“多视角选择 + 条件化输入”的收益，而不显著增加专家计算预算。","experiments":"主实验是在一个 24 层、10B 总参数、1B 激活参数的模型上进行，训练了 708B tokens。结果上，完整的 Multi-View MoE 相比 baseline 在九项下游任务平均分上提升 1.18 个百分点，达到 34.25；只用 Standard AR image models are tied to one token factorization, which makes native inpainting, outpainting, region editing, and non-contiguous conditioning hard. Existing any-order methods usually require training on mixed orderings from scratch, or moving to discrete diffusion with a different inference stack.","importance":"The useful idea for pretraining research is the separation between distributional knowledge and conditional access paths. A raster-scan AR model may already encode a strong joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is a way to express that knowledge under different target orderings. This matters for large-scale training practice because it suggests that some generation flexibility can be obtained through adaptation, rather than by paying the full pretraining cost again. The approach also keeps the model in the causal Transformer family, so KV caching, speculative decoding, and AR-oriented serving systems remain applicable.","technical_approach":"The adaptation recipe has two necessary components. First, future-aware positional embeddings tell the model which position will be predicted next. In causal any-order generation, the same observed context can correspond to different target tokens. Without target-position information, the model receives conflicting gradients because identical contexts require different outputs. The proposed positional signal fixes this identifiability issue while preserving a single-stream causal Transformer. Second, the paper uses an ordering curriculum that gradually moves from raster-scan order to fully random permutations. A sudden switch to random orderings produces large, high-variance updates and damages the pretrained representations before the model learns flexible routing. The curriculum provides a stable path from the pretrained raster-scan solution to an any-order solution.","experiments":"The experiments adapt pretrained AR image models including LlamaGen-L, LlamaGen-XL, and RAR-L/XL. sliding window attention，只保留最近 B 个 token；另一种是 prefill-based selection，在 prefill 阶段根据注意力聚合分数选出固定的一组历史 KV。前者强在 recency，弱在远程信息；后者强在 prompt 重要性，弱在随生成推进而变陈旧。RIFT 的核心想法是把预算拆给两类信息源：一部分给最近生成 后永久冻结，而是在生成过程中周期性重选。这样可以让“重要历史”随当前生成状态变化而更新，缓解 staleness。代价是额外 decode latency，因此论文给出的是一个 family：从不刷新、低频刷新到更积极刷新，形成质量与时延的折中。\n\n训练侧更有意思。作者指出，如果 draft 训练时总是看到完整 KV，而推理时只能看到压缩后的子集，那么即便压缩策略设计得好，也会有明显 per","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-26","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2610_32243.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"arxiv_url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32243","source_url":null,"summary":{"core_problem":"在 争抢同一硬件资源，且每个 rank 的存储/带宽成本偏高。论文要解决的是：在不牺牲太多延迟的前提下，用一种更适配 decode 硬件瓶颈（weight-traffic bound、CUDA cores 空闲）的修正形式，把 FP4 PTQ 的精度拉回去。","importance":"这篇工作更偏推理侧，但对“量化后如何用结构化残差补偿”给了一个很工程化、可落地的答案：把低秩修正从 BF16 乘法改成二值符号向量的加减累积，让修正分支主要吃 CUDA cores，从而与 Tensor Core 上的 FP4 GEMM 并行重叠。对做大模型部署/推理内核的人影响更直接；对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：1）权重矩阵的误差主要由 outlier/块尺度限制导致时，低秩/结构化补偿是比“更复杂量化器”更稳的路线；2）在训练-推理闭环里，若未来预训练阶段就考虑“可被二值低秩补偿”的权重结构（或对 kernel：同一次 launch 内，Tensor Core 执行主 NVFP4 GEMM；CUDA cores 并行计算二值低秩修正；在 GEMM epilogue 里把修正加回输出。这个设计点是全文的“为什么这样做而不是 SVDQuant”的核心：decode 形状下 GEMM 被 HBM 读权重拖住，Tensor Core 会 stall，而 CUDA cores 往往有空档，二值修正能吃掉这部分空档。","experiments":"论文给出的关键量化与性能结果集中在三个维度：\n1）表示能力（Frobenius norm 覆盖）：在与 BF16 rank-32 修正“相同向量存储预算”下，BiLoCo 可以用 rank 512 的二值因子；在多个 LLM 家族、三种模型尺寸上，二值 rank-512 可解释权重矩阵 Frobenius norm 的 47–53%，而 BF16 rank-32 只有 26–29%。\n2）精度（perplexity）：在 5 个模型上，BiLoCo 在 WikiText-2 / C4 的 perplexity 上与 BF16 rank-32 修正持平或更好（文中表述为 matches or improves）。\n3）延迟开销（batch=1 decode）：相对作者实现的“最快 FP4-only This makes it easier to reason about quantization error compensation, Hessian coupling, and uncertainty over codeword assignments in one framework. Because the quadratic term contains off-diagonal structure from XᵀX, the best codeword for one block depends on choices made by other blocks. Instead of committing to one codeword immediately, the paper defines a finite-temperature Gibbs posterior over all discrete assignments, where lower reconstruction energy gives higher posterior probability. Existing solvers correspond to a hard, zero-temperature limit that discards near-optimal alternatives. MPQ uses a two-stage solver: finite-temperature vector approximate message passing first propagates soft posterior information across blocks, then the posterior is converted into a hard initialization and refined with exact block coordinate descent. collapse；token-wise 累积显著增加有效样本量与统计多样性，让 A/G 两个 Kronecker 因子更满秩、更稳定，进而提升白化后的 SVD 截断质量。实现上仍保持推理友好：每个线性层 W 近似为 C(Bx) 的两层因子形式，bias 保持不变。","experiments":"论文给出的核心结果集中在两类指标：困惑度与下游准确率。\n- 分解质量（KFAC-SVD）：在 it","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-27T18:02:08Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2610_37778.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"arxiv_url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37778","source_url":null,"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是并行 位置的预测，会因为不同 sampled prefixes 对应到不同 verifier target。若把这些 target 分开蒸馏，训练会错误压低那些“在某些前缀下很合理、在另一些前缀下不合理”的 token，最终损害 acceptance length。","importance":"对预训练本身不是核心推进，但对新型语言建模范式和推理系统接口有实际意义。原因在于 one-step 分布做监督，相当于把互相冲突的条件分布都压到同一个无条件于块内前缀的学生头上，学生会学到一个被过度平均、甚至偏向保守的分布。\n\nMDraft 的核心思路是：不要把每个 draft 的 verifier target 分开蒸馏，而是先在多个 draft 上聚合 verifier 信号，再构造一个更稳定的训练目标。直观上，它试图逼近“对于当前上下文 c，这个并行位置哪些 token 上得到位置相关的分布或分数，再把这些信息聚合成单一 target 去训练 q。这样做的关键区别不在模型架构，而在 teacher target 的构造方式。它不是把 AR verifier 的条件分布硬塞给并行学生，而是先对 prefix 维度做边缘化近似。作者的论证也比较到位：如果目标是提高 speculative decoding 的 acceptance，而不是单纯最小化某个 teacher CE，那么训练目标就应该反映“跨可能前缀的可接受性”。","experiments":"实验部分的重点是 acceptance length，而不是常规语言建模 perplexity。作者在数学、代码、对话等多类 benchmark 上微调并评估并行 drafters，比较 MDraft 与现有 on-policy distillation 方法。结论是 MDraft 在整体平均 acceptance length 上最好，也就是 verifier 一次前向能接受更多草稿 token，从而带来更好的 speculative decoding 效率。摘要没有给出完整数字，但从正文叙述看，提升是稳定出现在多类任务上的，而不是只在单一领域有效。\n\n更重要的是实验支持了论文的机制判断：当训练把不同前缀下的 verifier target 分开处理时，会压制那些“条件性合理”的 specific training-target mismatch in speculative decoding with parallel diffusion drafters. A parallel drafter predicts all positions in a block from the same context, without conditioning on earlier sampled tokens inside that block. The verifier LLM, however, scores those positions autoregressively and therefore conditions on the sampled prefix. As a result, the same drafter prediction can correspond to different verifier targets under different sampled prefixes. This work shows that an accuracy gain can come from undirected flips near the decision boundary rather than better grounding in the context. That matters for long-context modeling, retrieval-augmented generation, and test-time compute: an intervention should be evaluated by whether it consistently moves predictions toward the evidence-supported answer, not only by whether the aggregate score increases.","technical_approach":"The study standardizes several context augmentation families under one sentence-level intervention protocol. Given a context split into sentences, it inserts an intervention after one sentence at a time and measures the model’s answer distribution on multiple-choice QA and fact-checking tasks. The five interventions span different information levels: Blank adds irrelevant filler tokens and mainly increases computation; Repeat copies the sentence; Paraphrase restates the same meaning with different wording; Self-explanation inserts an explanation generated by the evaluated model; Teacher-explanation inserts an explanation from an external teacher. Unlike earlier evaluations that use a single fixed insertion point, this protocol sweeps all sentence positions. The central finding is that gains from low-information interventions are often unreliable: they can be reproduced as prediction perturbations without a consistent direction. These methods mostly affect examples near the decision boundary, and the magnitude of flips toward and away from the correct answer is similar. Position matters strongly. Correct and incorrect predictions can be flipped from many positions in the same context, but successful positions cannot be predicted reliably from simple lexical features or by always inserting at the final position. 小时有序源视频。这样的任务分布更接近“有效上下文长度”而不是“名义上下文长度”的考察。对预训练研究员来说，这类 benchmark 有三层意义。第一，它能更清楚地区分模型能力与系统能力：底座 MLLM、外部记忆、RAG、工具路由、专用子模型各自贡献多少。第二，它把长视频问题从‘更多 token’转成‘记忆构建与目标驱动召回’，这和长文本 LM pipeline。和依赖模型内部视觉 token 改造的方法不同，这个 harness 试图把 memory、retrieval、skill orchestration、tool use 放到一个可插拔接口里。\n\n从全文描述看，harness 集成了四类互补技能、22+ window，也就是把任务跨度从底座模型的原生上下文长度中解耦。这一点很重要，因为它把 benchmark 的关注点从“谁能吃更长序列”转向“谁能更稳定地形成和使用长期记忆”。\n\n和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。第一，它不是只评模型，也不是只评 Repetition：模型最近说过的词会提高自己再次说出这些词的概率，形成正反馈，最后坍缩成重复。第三部分是 training-free intervention。针对前者，作者提出 Initialization-Anchor Pinning，固定保留第一个 KV entry，其余窗口照常滑动；针对后者，提出 Duplex Repetition Each event is paired with an evaluator-only Event Response Contract. The contract specifies required changes, work that must be preserved, prohibited side effects, required validation evidence, and the expected event outcome. not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is relevant to evaluation and training-signal quality. Batched LLM judging is widely used to reduce labeling and evaluation cost. If judgments depend on batch context, then labels used for benchmarks, automatic annotation, SFT data filtering, RL preference construction, or safety moderation can contain context-induced noise and systematic shifts. Aggregate AUROC or accuracy can remain nearly unchanged while many individual decisions flip, so standard validation may miss the problem.","technical_approach":"The authors formalize a batched judging context with three components: the item’s slot in the prompt, the membership of the batch, and the order of neighboring items. A judge is separable if the level assigned to an item is identical across all such contexts. The experiments grade the same 2,000 items per task alone and under multiple randomized batched conditions. The tasks are harm judgment for social-media comments, short-answer grading, and review star ratings. The main runs use five open-weight models in the 4–9B range, with follow-up runs on four 14–32B models. The design includes baselines such as renamed item keys, reworded instructions, and single-prompt generation. It also includes controlled changes to slot, neighbor order, and batch membership. 明确。然后系统性控制若干变量：每个事实被多少文档重复表达、总事实数、是否加入与 query 词面相似但语义无关的 lexical distractors、以及文档组织方式。这样可以单独观察每个因素如何影响 recall。\n\n第二部分是算法诊断与修正。作者先做 token-level attribution 分析，发现真正承载因果证据的通常只是文档中的少数 token，而标准做法常把 token 分数在整篇文档上平均或求和，导致背景 token 把信号稀释。围绕这个现象，作者测试了两个此前没有被充分重视的设计维度。其一是 loss：把常见 cross-entropy 换成 token-level negative log-odds。原因是当目标 token 已经被模型高置信预测时，cross-entropy 的梯度会接近 0，反而压低最关键证据的可见性；negative log-odds 去掉了这种 confidence saturation，更容易把支持目标输出的 token 拉出来。其二是 aggregation：不再对整篇文档平均，而是只取 top-k token attribution score 聚合成文档分数。这样做等于显式假设“证据是局部的”，从而对冗余文本和干扰词更稳健。\n\n论文并不局限于某一种 attribution estimator，而是在 TRAK、EK-FAC、Grad-Dot 等多种 gradient-based 方法上测试这些改动，说明作者关注的是 attribution pipeline 的公共瓶颈，而不是某个方法的局部调参。","experiments":"关键结果很集中。第一，CATT 上最显著的现象是 dilution：随着同一事实在更多文档中重复，或加入更多与 query 词面相似的 distractor，现有方法的 fact-tracing recall 明显下降。这个退化不是偶然噪声，而是在多种方法、多个数据设置下都稳定出现。第二，token-level negative log-odds 加上 top-k token aggregation 后，fact-tracing recall 在多种 attribution 方法和数据配置上提升 35 到 72 个百分点，幅度很大，说明问题主要出在信号提取和聚合，而不是只出在二阶近似或 influence 估计误差。\n\n第三，作者把结论外推到真实 benchmark FTRACE-TREX。这里不再有合成数据的绝对可控性，因此作者用 counterfactual retraining performance 作为外部验证。结果是对 TRAK、EK-FAC、Grad-Dot，token-level 都直接相关。更重要的是，论文实证表明 Pass@K 与 Seq@K 排名并不等价，说明如果只用反馈盲的指标做模型选择，可能会选错模型，也会误判训练方向。对基座研究员来说，这意味着两件事：第一，预训练或后训练是否提升了“反馈利用能力”，需要单独测；第二，未来做 reasoning / coding / tool-use 数据合成时，反馈格式本身也是训练信号设计的一部分，而不是评测细节。","technical_approach":"方法上并不复杂，但定义得很干净。论文把 actor、critic、grader 三个角色拆开。Pass@K 下，模型在固定原始 prompt 上独立采样 K 次；Seq@K 下，第 t 次尝试的上下文包含历史回答和反馈，即 H_{t-1}=((Y1,F1),...,(Y_{t-1},F_{t-1}))。因此两者在形式上都问“预算 K 内是否至少成功一次”，但一个考察独立采样覆盖率，另一个考察条件修正能力。\n\n论文的贡献不只是给出定义，还系统研究了 feedback mode。反馈可以来自 verifier、rubric-based critique、不同粒度的错误信息，甚至历史摘要方式也会影响结果。作者特别强调 RL 中的可验证奖励都会被污染。论文聚焦的现象是 stale authoritative information：模型先看到一个任务相关值，之后底层权威记录发生变化，模型在后续步骤里是否会基于过期信息做决定。关键难点不在于“加一个扰动”，而在于证明这个扰动确实发生、任务仍然可解、模型确实接收到了应有观察、最终判分也有证据支撑。","importance":"对预训练研究本身，它不是直接提出新的 能力里剥离出来，形成一套可执行认证流程。对于做基座模型的人，这件事有两层启发。第一，很多所谓 agent failure 其实是训练信号质量问题；如果环境变更、观测分发、checker 判定不可靠，RL 学到的是噪声奖励。第二，动态环境评测不能只给 terminal success rate，需要保留证据链，区分 authoritative state mutation、page benchmark，而是一套从任务构造、事前认证到事后审计的流程。作者先定义 phenomenon，即应用无关的环境变化类型；再用 executable perturbation 把它实例化，明确四个要素：状态变换算子、触发条件、观测通道、以及 single-execution guard，避免重复触发或副作用失控。随后，一个候选评测单元由 seeded world、perturbation、endpoint criteria 和 verifier 组成，但不会直接投入评测，而是先经过一组 scoped tests。根据引言给出的描述，这些测试至少覆盖五类：状态转移是否真的发生；观测是否一致地送达策略；任务在变更后是否仍可解；checker 是否能区分正确与错误行为；checker 本身对记录损坏或异常轨迹是否稳健。\n\n论文另一个重要设计是把“世界状态变化”和“信息披露方式”分开控制。在 clinic booking 与 insurance approval 两个场景里，底层 authoritative state 都会变化，但实验主比较不是“静态环境 vs 动态环境”，而是 review step 给 agent 多少更新信息。clinic 里有 OFF-A、CUE-A、LIVE-A：分别是不额外提示、提示去核验并给原始记录链接、直接展示当前更新值。insurance 里则是 OFF-A 与 ON-A：审批时是否重新暴露当前 policy。这样设计的好处是，作者测到的是 review-time information effect，而不是把多个因素混在一起。作者还强调 source page 始终可访问，因此“是否回看原始来源”被记录为行为，而不是预设成功条件。\n\n在评测有效性上，EnvOS 还要求 prospective experiments 预注册设计与计数规则，隔离 policy 与 evaluator 数据，并在运行后基于归档证据用独立代码重建 verdict terms。这个“separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence”的设计很关键，因为它把 grader 从单点信任对象变成可复核对象。对于依赖程序化奖励的 RL 训练，这等于在 reward pipeline 上加了一层审计。","experiments":"全文片段里给出的实验信息主要是定性和部分相对结论，没有完整表格数字，但主线很清楚。作者在两个应用上验证 EnvOS：一是 clinic booking，任务中诊所地点会在中途变化；二是 insurance-claim approval，policy limit 会在模型计算批准金额前发生变化。两者都要求先确认环境变更确实发生，再比较不同 review 信息条件下 agent 的表现。\n\n关键结果有三点。第一，在 clinic booking 中，直接把更新后的 location 展示给 agent 的 LIVE-A about making computer-use agents stronger. It addresses a more foundational issue: how to build and audit evaluations when the environment can change mid-episode in ways that alter the authoritative state. In such settings, an observed failure may come from the agent, from a perturbation that did not actually fire as intended, or from a grader/verifier that assigned the wrong verdict. The paper focuses on stale authoritative information: the agent first observes a task-relevant value, the underlying record changes later, and the agent must act after that change. The hard part is not adding a perturbation, but proving that the perturbation happened at the right time, that the task remained solvable, that the agent received the intended observations, and that the final judgment is supported by archived evidence.","importance":"For pretraining researchers, the contribution is indirect but useful, especially at the pretrain–post-train boundary. Its main contribution is methodological: it separates environment correctness and evaluation correctness from agent capability. That matters because many apparent agent failures are really training-signal failures. If state changes, observation delivery, or checkers are unreliable, the reward signal is corrupted before any policy learning issue enters the picture. The paper also offers a clean decomposition of dynamic-environment evaluation into authoritative state mutation, page serve, model observation, and agent comprehension. lookahead。TTS 侧比较了两种格式：fixed-ratio 和 time-aligned。fixed-ratio 按固定 token/frame 比例切块，简单但和真实发音边界脱节；time-aligned 则按词推进，并给后续若干词 lookahead，训练时用对齐信息决定每个 speech chunk 的边界。作者发现 time-aligned 更适合流式 TTS，因为它把文本窗口和声学边界绑得更紧，减少了 chunk 切分带来的韵律和发音错误。\n\n第二是 backbone 选择与输入表示。作者基于 VibeVoice 家族来做统一，原因不是它“现成可用”这么简单，而是 TTS 和 ASR 变体在架构上足够接近，尤其共享同一套 speech tokenizer，这让统一训练时的离散语音表示空间是一致的，避免了两个任务各自用不同 又会反过来伤害合成质量，所以需要 anchoring 去稳住。文中还做了表示探针，比较不同层、不同任务、不同模态的隐藏状态相似性，用来回答“统一训练后内部是否真的融合”这个问题。","experiments":"实验里最重要的不是单一分数，而是几组对照关系。第一，流式 TTS 的数据格式比较中，time-aligned interleaving 比 fixed-ratio 有更低的 TTS 的编辑才构成真正矛盾；如果编辑发生在另一视角不可见区域，两张图仍然是兼容的。这样可以测模型是否理解“哪些证据应该一致”。第三，空间推理任务要求模型结合多个视角来判断物体间物理邻近关系，避免只靠单视角局部线索。\n\n数据构建上，样本来自真实多视角场景数据集 DL3DV-10K，并做人工验证。全文强调 benchmark For RL, process supervision, and reasoning-trace training, this distinction matters: a higher monitor hit rate does not necessarily mean the model is more transparent about what changed its behavior.","technical_approach":"The paper first reframes intervention monitorability as a causal detection problem. The authors also derive an observable lower bound, TPR_lb, so the true causal detection rate is constrained by two measurable quantities rather than inferred from TPR_mc alone. The second part builds paired control-intervention training data across four intervention families: contextual evidence, answer cues, sandbagging, and deception. The data cover multiple-choice, numeric, and open-ended answers. 信号有两种不同作用：一类是把训练轨迹拉到更可能成功的区域，解决“采不到正样本”；另一类是给局部 token 提供稠密监督，解决“即使有好轨迹，学生也未必学得会”。如果只做前者，teacher 轨迹可能偏离学生分布，难以模仿；如果只做后者，学生已经走偏时，局部蒸馏也救不回来。论文的核心问题就是：怎样把 teacher 纠错同时用于轨迹构造和 token 监督，让 RLVR 在 hard 提供了一个更清楚的设计框架：trajectory intervention 和 token supervision 是互补而不是替代关系。这个结论对后续做 reasoning mid-training、online distillation、以及 RL 与 imitation 混合目标的工作都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它不是改写 RLVR 基础算法，而是把 teacher correction 以在线、局部、可继续 rollout 的方式嵌进 RLVR 流程，并系统分析了介入位置、KL 形式和强度，属于训练 recipe 层面较扎实的一步。","technical_approach":"PIVOT 的做法可以概括为“在线局部纠错 + 继续采样 + 纠错段蒸馏”。训练时先由学生生成 rollout 前缀，在某个选定位置插入 teacher correction：teacher 不是整条代写，而是基于学生当前前缀给出一个纠正片段；随后学生从这个被纠正过的上下文继续生成后续 token。这样得到的 teacher-assisted trajectory 一方面更容易通向 verifier 可判对的终局，另一方面又保留了学生自己的续写分布，减少纯 teacher trajectory 带来的分布错位。\n\n优化目标有两部分。第一部分仍是 verifier 驱动的 RLVR/GRPO，对最终整条轨迹按 outcome reward 做策略优化；这保证训练目标仍对齐于可验证正确性，而不是单纯模仿 teacher。第二部分是在 teacher correction 覆盖的 token 段上加入 teacher-student KL，让学生在这些关键局部位置学习 teacher 的条件分布。作者把这看成 dense token-level supervision，只在纠错段施加，而不是全序列蒸馏，因此更聚焦于“把轨迹拉回正确推理流形”的关键位置。\n\n从机制上看，这个设计同时解决了两件事。在线纠错改变了 rollout distribution，提高 reward-bearing trajectories 的出现率；局部 KL 则让学生对这些纠错片段形成可复制的参数更新，而不是只把成功归因于 teacher 的一次性介入。论文还讨论了几个关键设计点：何时介入、介入多少、KL 用在什么位置、teacher guidance 强度如何设定。作者的结论是，过早介入可能让训练退化成 teacher 主导，过晚介入又难以挽救已经偏离太远的轨迹；只做 intervention 或只做 KL 都不稳定，联合使用效果最好。","experiments":"实验主要覆盖两类任务：SynLogic The authors argue that adding a stronger teacher is not sufficient by itself, because teacher guidance serves two different roles. One role is to alter the sampled trajectories so that reward-bearing rollouts become reachable. The other is to provide dense token-level supervision so the student can actually absorb the correction. Using only trajectory intervention can create a distribution gap between teacher trajectories and student behavior; using only token-level supervision can fail when the student rollout has already drifted too far from any valid reasoning path. That matters for reasoning-focused mid-training, online distillation, and hybrid RL+imitation recipes. 蒸馏。问题在于，这类方法依赖外部信息，适用面受限，而且 teacher 条件分布与 student 推理时分布并不一致。WISD 反过来构造一个“更弱的自己”，利用原模型与弱化模型在同一 on-policy 轨迹上的 token 偏好差异，作为无需外部监督的训练信号。","importance":"它属于 post-train reasoning 方法，但和预训练研究的接口很直接，尤其是自蒸馏、无标注数据利用、teacher-free policy improvement 这几个方向。重要性主要在三点。第一，它把 weak-to-strong OPD 的思路推进到完全自给自足的 setting：不需要外部 teacher，也不需要 privileged context，只要有 prompt 和当前模型即可。第二，它提出的
